meta.title: ADA Restroom Accessibility Inspection
meta.description: Answer all questions. If you select NO, review the suggested correction.

questions.title: Requirement 3.1
questions.question: If toilet rooms are available to the public, is at least one toilet room accessible?
questions.help: Note: If toilet rooms are chiefly for children, e.g., in elementary schools and day care centers, use the children’s specifications in Toilets - 604.1, 604.8, 604.9, 609.4 and Lavatories and Sinks – 606.2.
solutionsIfNo: Combine toilet rooms to create one unisex accessible toilet room

questions.title: Requirement 3.2
questions.question: Are there signs at inaccessible toilet rooms that give directions to accessible toilet rooms?

questions.title: Requirement 3.3
questions.question: Is there an International Symbol of Accessibility sign at accessible toilet rooms?

questions.title: Requirement 3.4
questions.question: Are signs mounted at the correct location and height for identification?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5
questions.question: Do text characters contrast with their backgrounds?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5.1
questions.question: Are text characters raised?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5.2
questions.question: Is there Braille?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5.3
questions.question: Is the sign mounted on the wall on the latch side of the door?

questions.title: Requirement 3.6
questions.question: Is the door opening at least 32 inches clear width?

questions.title: Requirement 3.7
questions.question: If there is a front approach to the pull side of the door is there at least 18 inches of maneuvering clearance beyond the latch side plus 60 inches clear depth?

questions.title: Requirement 3.7.1
questions.question: On both sides of the door, is the floor surface of the maneuvering clearance level (no steeper than 1:48)?

questions.title: Requirement 3.8
questions.question: If the threshold is vertical is it no more than ¼ inch high?

questions.title: Requirement 3.8.1
questions.question: Is the threshold no more than ½ inch high with the top ¼ inch beveled no steeper than 1:2 (installed on or after 1/26/93)?

questions.title: Requirement 3.8.2
questions.question: Is the threshold no more than ¾ inch high with the top ½ inch beveled no steeper than 1:2 (installed before 1/26/93)?

questions.title: Requirement 3.9
questions.question: Can the door be opened with one hand and without tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist?

questions.title: Requirement 3.10
questions.question: If the door has a closer, does it take at least 5 seconds to close from 90 degrees to 12 degrees?

questions.title: Requirement 3.11
questions.question: Is the door opening force no greater than 5 pounds?

questions.title: Requirement 3.12
questions.question: Does the door have a smooth surface on the push side within 10 inches of the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.13
questions.question: Is there a turning space inside the toilet room (60-inch diameter circle or T-turn)?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure layout to provide turning space

questions.title: Requirement 3.14
questions.question: Does the door swing not interfere with required clear floor spaces at fixtures?

questions.title: Requirement 3.15
questions.question: Is there an accessible route to all compartments and fixtures in the toilet room?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure layout to provide accessible route

questions.title: Requirement 3.16
questions.question: Are objects not protruding in a way that reduces circulation paths?

questions.title: Requirement 3.17
questions.question: Is the accessible route at least 36 inches wide?

questions.title: Requirement 3.18
questions.question: Are floor surfaces stable, firm, and slip resistant?

questions.title: Requirement 3.19
questions.question: Is there at least one accessible toilet compartment?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure stalls to create an accessible compartment

questions.title: Requirement 3.20
questions.question: Is there an ambulatory accessible compartment where required?
solutionsIfNo: Reconfigure stalls to create an ambulatory compartment

questions.title: Requirement 3.21
questions.question: Is the front of the lavatory or counter surface no higher than 34 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.22
questions.question: Is there adequate knee clearance under the lavatory?

questions.title: Requirement 3.23
questions.question: Is the front of the lavatory or counter surface, whichever is higher, no more than 34 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.24
questions.question: Is there at least 27 inches clearance from the floor to the bottom of the lavatory that extends at least 8 inches under the lavatory for knee clearance?

questions.title: Requirement 3.25
questions.question: Is there toe clearance at least 9 inches high?

questions.title: Requirement 3.26
questions.question: Are pipes below the lavatory insulated or otherwise configured to protect against contact?

questions.title: Requirement 3.27
questions.question: Can faucet controls be operated with one hand and without tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist?

questions.title: Requirement 3.27.1
questions.question: Is the force required to activate the faucet controls no greater than 5 pounds?

questions.title: Requirement 3.28
questions.question: Is there clear floor space positioned for a forward approach at the lavatory?

questions.title: Requirement 3.29
questions.question: Is the bottom edge of the reflecting surface of the mirror no higher than 40 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.30
questions.question: Is the centerline of the water closet 16 to 18 inches from the side wall or partition?

questions.title: Requirement 3.31
questions.question: Is the height of the water closet seat 17 to 19 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.32
questions.question: Is there adequate clearance around the water closet for a wheelchair?

questions.title: Requirement 3.33
questions.question: Are grab bars provided at the water closet?

questions.title: Requirement 3.34
questions.question: Are grab bars mounted 33 to 36 inches above the floor to the top of the gripping surface?
solutionsIfNo: Reinstall grab bars at correct height

questions.title: Requirement 3.35
questions.question: Is the toilet paper dispenser located within reach and not behind the grab bars?

questions.title: Requirement 3.36
questions.question: If the flush control is hand operated, can it be operated with one hand and without tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist?

questions.title: Requirement 3.36.1
questions.question: Is the force required to activate the flush control no greater than 5 pounds?

questions.title: Requirement 3.37
questions.question: Is the flush control on the open side of the water closet?

questions.title: Requirement 3.38
questions.question: In the accessible toilet compartment, is the door self-closing and does it not swing into the required clear floor space?

questions.title: Requirement 3.39
questions.question: Does the accessible toilet compartment meet the required size and clearances?

questions.title: Requirement 3.39.1
questions.question: Is the accessible compartment door opening at least 32 inches clear?

questions.title: Requirement 3.40
questions.question: If urinals are provided, is at least one urinal accessible?

questions.title: Requirement 3.41
questions.question: Is the urinal rim no higher than 17 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.42
questions.question: Is there clear floor space for a forward approach at the urinal?
measurements: 30 x 48 inches min clear floor space

questions.title: Requirement 3.43
questions.question: Are operable parts (dispensers/controls) usable with one hand without tight grasping, pinching, or twisting?

questions.title: Requirement 3.43.1
questions.question: Is the force required to operate dispensers/controls no greater than 5 pounds?

questions.title: Requirement 3.44
questions.question: Are soap dispensers within accessible reach range and not blocking required clear floor space?

questions.title: Requirement 3.45
questions.question: Are paper towel dispensers or hand dryers within accessible reach range and not blocking required clear floor space?

questions.title: Requirement 3.46
questions.question: Is the mirror mounted with the bottom edge of the reflecting surface no higher than 40 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.47
questions.question: Is the coat hook and/or shelf (if provided) mounted within accessible reach range?

questions.title: Requirement 3.48
questions.question: Are waste receptacles placed so they do not obstruct required clear floor space at fixtures?

questions.title: Requirement 3.49
questions.question: Are all required elements maintained in operable working condition (no broken dispensers, loose grab bars, etc.)?

questions.title: Requirement 3.50
questions.question: Are there any other barriers that prevent access or use by people with disabilities?
